words.example: Housekeeping today means water, spare chairs, and the direction signs.
words.exampleZh: 今天的会务杂务包括饮水、备用椅子和指示牌。

words.example: Run an AV check in the auditorium before anyone sits down.
words.exampleZh: 大家入座之前，请在礼堂做一次音视频检查。

words.example: The podium microphone stayed silent through the whole opening.
words.exampleZh: 主席台上的麦克风在整个开场过程中都没有声音。

words.example: Please use the speakerphone so colleagues off site can hear us.
words.exampleZh: 请用免提电话，让不在现场的同事也能听见。

words.example: The projector in room C cannot focus on the far screen.
words.exampleZh: C室的投影仪对不准远处那块屏幕。

words.example: The distribution point at the east campus ran out of disk during the viewer push.
words.exampleZh: 推送阅片程序的时候，东院区分发点的磁盘用完了。

words.example: Clients at the annex cannot find a management point, so they never pick up policy.
words.exampleZh: 附楼的客户端找不到管理点，所以一直拿不到策略。

words.example: The client agent on the pharmacy PC stopped reporting after yesterday's patch.
words.exampleZh: 昨天的补丁之后，药房电脑上的客户端代理停止上报了。

words.example: Shorten the heartbeat interval if you need faster notice when a clinic PC drops.
words.exampleZh: 如果希望门诊电脑掉线时更快知道，就把心跳间隔缩短。

words.example: Policy refresh on the ward PCs picked up the new screen-lock setting within the hour.
words.exampleZh: 病区电脑的策略刷新在一小时内拿到了新的锁屏设置。
